fixes: Shape the shoulder/trapezius line: slope from neck base to acromion, then a distinct deltoid curve instead of a pillow

Clump the outer hair cards to the hair volume so no single card leaves the mass by more than a few millimetres
Push the ears out so the helix shows in the front silhouette
Give the shoulder line a trapezius slope and a clear shoulder point instead of one rounded pillow
Shorten the neck ~15% and thicken it (sternocleidomastoid + trapezius slope) so the head sits on the shoulders
Push the occiput back so the skull is deeper than the face in side view
Give the shoulder block a trapezius slope and deltoid cap instead of a rounded cushion

fixes: Shorten the neck ~15-20% and widen it toward the trapezius; add SCM and Adam's-apple forms
Deepen the orbits and raise the brow ridge; enlarge the eyeballs slightly and add upper/lower lid thickness
Push cheekbones and the nose bridge forward; widen the mouth to pupil-to-pupil width with fuller lip volumes
Increase the occipital mass so the skull is a proper egg in side view
Deepen the orbits and add an upper lid fold and brow ridge so the eyeball sits 12-15 mm behind the brow
Enlarge the eye opening to about one fifth of the face width with one eye width between them
Scale the ear up to span brow line to nose base and sculpt helix, antihelix and tragus
Add sternomastoid, clavicles and the jugular notch to the neck and chest
Recess the eyeballs into proper orbits with a modelled upper lid crease and brow overhang
Lengthen the nasal bridge and narrow the alar base; define the philtrum and lip shapes
Raise the ears to brow-to-nose-base height and angle them ~15 degrees off the skull
